summary: Wittman signed an October 2025 letter opposing Ireland's OTI import ban and ICJ genocide-redefinition efforts, characterizing both as targeting Israel and empowering Hamas. His legislative record reinforces this defense: a May 2024 yea vote on H.R. 6090 and a February 2025 sponsorship of H.R. 1007, each embedding the IHRA definition of antisemitism in federal education-enforcement law.
